checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: A water bottle is the main subject and is fully visible.
must.why: Whole bottle centered with space around it.

must.item: The bottle has a matte black finish rather than a glossy or metallic finish.
must.why: Bottle is brushed silver stainless steel, not black.

must.item: The bottle stands on a visibly veined marble surface.
must.why: Plain white seamless background, no marble.

must.item: Lighting is soft, with gentle shadows rather than harsh glare.
must.why: Soft studio light with a faint shadow, though there are some metallic highlights.

faults.what: Bottle is silver metallic, not matte black as required.
No veined marble surface; plain white background instead.

summary: A clean, well-lit silver steel bottle on white came out, but it is not matte black and has no marble surface, so it misses two key requirements.
